properties.description: Detects NMap or active scanning attempts against App Service from Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Maps to MITRE ATT&CK T1595 / T1046.
properties.query:
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ProductName contains 'App Service'
| where AlertName contains 'scan' or AlertName contains 'NMap' or AlertName contains 'fingerprint'
| extend SourceIP = tostring(parse_json(ExtendedProperties)["Sample Source IP Addresses"])
| extend TargetURI = tostring(parse_json(ExtendedProperties)["Sample URIs"])
| extend UserAgent = tostring(parse_json(ExtendedProperties)["Sample User Agents"])
| project TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, CompromisedEntity, SourceIP, TargetURI, UserAgent
